title: Full Stack Platform Engineer
description: Our company is an English teaching platform. We offer 1 on 1 classes hosted on Google Meet. Our course material is set and students can pick up where they last left off with any teacher on the platform, allowing them to take classes based on their availability. Alongside our coursework we have additional practices, and an application we built to allow them to continue learning outside of the live sessions. Students come onto the platform and can book these 1 on 1 sessions based on the availability on the site. This booking can be done through our calendar where they choose a time availability and then a teacher that is available within that time, or they can choose a specific teacher and then book based on their availability. For our teachers they place their availability in the system, students can then book one hour long live lessons based on that availability. Teachers have the ability to unlock lessons for the students from their dashboard after a class is completed so that students can view their new practices/resources for the completed class. Teachers can also leave notes on students so that the next teacher can pick up where the previous teacher left off. From our admin panel we have the ability to edit our landing page, add or take away teachers, delete students or add credits to their account, change our pricing of our packages, add content and lessons, we have an overview of some analytics, and a few other additional features. Our system works based on credits, students can buy individual or packages of credits. Our transactions are currently conducted through stripe. A single credit is deducted from students' credits when a class is booked. When a teacher teaches a live class they will have $10 added to their payout balance. The system is then meant to recognize how much the teacher is owed for the week and automatically pay them out on Sunday from our stripe balance. Our system also automatically generates the Google meets link for both our student and teacher, based off the booking they made on our platform. Our system has some set rules for booking and cancellations that it automatically applies. Additionally, our system sends automated reminders and confirmations for classes. What we are looking for: Someone to come and resolve our current issues, and potentially add additional features. Focus Role: Full Stack Platform Engineer / SaaS Product Developer 1. Define the Primary Objectives The purpose of this role is to: Stabilize the current platform infrastructure Resolve production-level payment and booking issues Improve scheduling/calendar functionality Improve teacher and student user experience Implement scalable company account functionality Expand reporting, analytics, and administrative tools Improve mobile responsiveness and multilingual support The developer should be capable of both: Debugging existing systems Building scalable new product features 2. Immediate Priority Issues (Critical Fixes) A. Stripe Automatic Payout Failure Current issue: Teachers are not receiving automatic Sunday payouts despite successful student payments through Stripe. Developer responsibilities: Audit Stripe Connect configuration Review payout automation logic Review webhook handling and cron jobs Review failed payout logs Verify international payout support for Latin America and USA Implement reliable payout retry/error handling Ensure payout tracking visibility inside admin dashboard Expected outcome: Fully automated, stable weekly teacher payouts B. Student Booking Error Current issue: Students attempting to book available classes receive: “Slot not available or already booked” Developer responsibilities: Audit booking transaction logic Review concurrency/duplicate booking handling Review database slot locking logic Verify frontend/backend slot synchronization Improve booking reliability and error messaging Expected outcome: Students can reliably book available classes without false conflicts C. Teacher Timezone & Availability Issues Current issue: Teacher availability dates shift incorrectly for some users. Example: Thursday May 28 displays as Wednesday May 27. Developer responsibilities: Audit timezone conversion logic Verify UTC storage handling Review frontend/browser timezone interpretation Standardize timezone behavior across devices Ensure teacher local time displays correctly to students in their own timezone Expected outcome: Accurate global scheduling across all user regions D. Stripe Teacher Connection Errors Current issues: Some teachers cannot connect Stripe Some cannot reconnect/disconnect “Stripe Connected” remains incorrectly Teachers receive onboarding errors Developer responsibilities: Rebuild Stripe onboarding flow Improve Stripe Connect account reset/reconnect functionality Improve onboarding validation and logging Improve user-facing error handling Expected outcome: Reliable Stripe onboarding and reconnection flow E. Calendar Slot Generation Current issue: Continuous availability is not splitting into bookable hourly classes. Example: 3PM–6PM should automatically create: 3PM–4PM 4PM–5PM 5PM–6PM Developer responsibilities: Create automatic slot generation logic Prevent duplicate or overlapping slots Ensure slots display correctly for students and teachers Expected outcome: Fully functional class slot generation system F. Form Validation Improvements Current issue: Users receive generic “Error” or “Zod Error” messages. Developer responsibilities: Create field-specific validation messages Improve onboarding UX Improve frontend validation handling Expected outcome: Clear, actionable form error messages G. Mobile & UX Improvements Mobile PDF Issue PDFs do not display correctly on phones Language Switcher Mobile language switcher missing Spanish should be default option for Spanish-speaking users Student Payment/Booking Flow Students sometimes receive payment redirect errors despite successful purchases Developer responsibilities: Improve mobile responsiveness Improve multilingual UX Improve post-payment flow handling Improve session persistence and redirects Expected outcome: Stable and mobile-friendly user experience 3. Secondary Platform Improvements A. Admin Credit Controls Current issue: Admins can add credits but cannot remove them. Developer responsibilities: Create full credit adjustment system Add audit logs for credit changes B. Platform Messaging Accuracy Current issue: “Trusted by 1000+ students” is inaccurate. Developer responsibilities: Remove or replace inaccurate social proof messaging 4. Future Product Expansion Features A. Company Accounts System Goal: Allow businesses to purchase and manage credits for employees. Required functionality: Company account creation Shared company credit pools Multiple students under one organization Company-level reporting Company usage analytics Employee activity tracking Credit balance visibility Admin dashboard should show: Company usage Credits remaining Weekly classes used Student activity Teacher dashboard behavior should remain unchanged. B. Advanced Analytics & Reporting Goal: Improve platform insights and operational visibility. Potential features: Revenue tracking Teacher utilization Student attendance Credit usage reports Company analytics Booking trends Cancellation rates C. Weekly Calendar Navigation Goal: Allow students to browse multiple weeks of teacher availability. Required functionality: Weekly calendar view Forward/backward week navigation Faster availability browsing D. Improved Student Notes System Goal: Expand lesson notes and student tracking. Potential features: Teacher lesson notes Student learning history Saved corrections Homework/resources Shared progress tracking 5. Candidate Requirements Preferred technical experience: React / Next.js Node.js Stripe & Stripe Connect PostgreSQL or relational databases Scheduling/calendar systems SaaS platforms API integrations OAuth/Google integrations Mobile-responsive frontend development Strongly preferred: Experience debugging live production applications Experience with international timezone systems Strong product-thinking and UX awareness

About Bitrograde Labs Bitrograde Labs ships small, complete, fairly-priced games on a fast cadence — and helps outside creators finish and launch theirs. No DLC. No microtransactions. Complete games at honest prices. Remember when gaming was fun? We build by directing AI agents, not by typing code line by line. Your job is to make that produce shippable games — not demos that fall apart in the wild. How You'll Work (read this part twice) You will not hand-write most of the code. You'll orchestrate AI agents (Claude Code and similar) to do it. But "doesn't type code" is not "doesn't read code." You are the judgment in the loop: you architect the approach, review what the agents produce, catch them when they're confidently wrong, and refuse to ship what you can't explain. This is the difference between agentic engineering — which works — and vibe coding — which passes a quick test and breaks later. We do the former. The Role You alternate between two modes, never both at once: Build mode: direct AI agents to take a prototype to a finished, shippable game — ~80% in Godot (GDScript), the rest in web tech (JavaScript/TypeScript). Port mode (after a game ships): get finished titles onto every platform that makes sense. This is roughly a 50/50 split — you'll spend about as much time porting finished titles as building new ones. The team handles go-to-market, so you stay focused on the game and the build. What You'll Do In build mode: Direct AI agents to build games in Godot (primary) and web/JS (occasional) Architect the approach and write tight specs/constraints before the agents start Read, review, and debug everything the agents produce — own it as if you'd typed it Run adversarial cross-checks (e.g. a second model reviewing significant changes) and fix what they surface Polish, harden, and ship In port mode: Godot titles: desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux) and mobile via Godot export; console (Switch 1 & 2 / PS5 / Xbox Series) via W4 Consoles middleware Web titles: desktop via Electron/Tauri, mobile via Capacitor, plus Steam and Apple TV Handle platform integration (controllers, achievements, saves), certification, and store submission For a web title that earns a console release: scope and coordinate a native rebuild or an external porting partner (no push-button path exists for web ? console) Must Have You're a gamer. You play, you have taste, you know what "finished and fun" feels like. Hands-on agentic AI development experience. You've actually shipped by orchestrating AI coding agents — not just chatted with a model. You can read, review, and debug Godot / GDScript fluently. You don't have to love typing it, but you must catch a bad implementation, reason about architecture, and explain any line the AI wrote. If you can't read it, you don't ship it — and we treat "the AI wrote it and nobody understands it" as a fireable risk, not a feature. At least one shipped game. Any size — you've crossed the finish line before. Comfortable with build pipelines (GitHub Actions / CI-CD, multi-platform builds). Nice to Have Web game experience (JavaScript/TypeScript, Electron/Tauri/Capacitor) for the ~20% non-Godot titles Prior console work (W4 Consoles; certification for Nintendo / Sony / Microsoft) Mobile and Apple TV deployment Familiarity with agent orchestration workflows and ---------- build tooling You'll Thrive Here If You actually finish things You think a complete game at a fair price is a moral stance, not just a business model "Remember when gaming was fun" makes you nod APPLY HERE: ----------

title: DevOps & Systems Tech Wizard Wanted
description: // who we're looking for We are looking for a tech wizard — a genuine enthusiast, a self-described nerd, a person who tinkers because they can't help themselves. Someone who has opinions about encryption protocols at midnight and has probably already broken and rebuilt their own home server stack for fun. This is a long-term relationship, and we're treating it like one. We are starting small — a handful of hours per week — while we mutually vet and validate fit. We'll be testing your knowledge, your thinking, your instincts. If you're the real deal, the hours grow, the trust grows, and so does the opportunity. If you have the credentials, the curiosity, and the character — we're not just hiring you. We're building with you. Equity conversations are on the table for the right long-term partner. We are building an advanced, multi-layer technical infrastructure. We need someone who can grow into it, ideally from the ground floor. You don't need to check every box. But you need to be deeply, personally invested in technology — and we need to be able to see that in how you write, what you know, and where you spend your time online. // core technical requirements Server & Infrastructure VPS server stack setup, management, and maintenance Back-end network infrastructure design and administration Linux proficiency — command line fluency is non-negotiable VOIP system configuration and network integration Webhooks, CI/CD concepts, automated deployment pipelines N8N workflow automation (preferred over simpler drag-and-drop tools) Web Development Full-stack or strong back-end web development capabilities API integration — building, connecting, and maintaining third-party APIs Database management: design, optimization, and security WordPress and web design experience a plus Security & Privacy Linux penetration testing fundamentals Encryption and privacy protocol literacy Cipher knowledge, VPN configuration and management Familiarity with Tails OS, Tor, Qubes OS Crypto and digital asset basic operations // tooling & workflow proficiency You will be working inside a modern, tool-rich environment. Comfort navigating and connecting these systems is essential: ClickUp Google Workspace Obsidian N8N GitHub / Git Webhooks REST APIs Linux CLI VPS Providers VOIP Systems LLM & AI Integration — this is a serious requirement, not an afterthought: Must have genuine, working knowledge of multiple leading LLM platforms Understand prompt engineering at a functional level — tokens, context windows, model selection for specific use cases Know the differences between models and when to deploy which for what purpose Capable of doing all work manually and independently — AI tools enhance your output, they do not replace your skill We will provide full subscription access to multiple leading AI platforms for use in our projects. You bring the expertise; we supply the tools. Blockchain Familiarity (preferred, not required): You don't need to be a blockchain developer, but a working familiarity with blockchain fundamentals is a meaningful plus. If it's already in your world — even casually — flag it. // programming languages We expect proficiency in at least several programming languages relevant to systems, back-end, and automation work. In your application, please tell us specifically: Which languages you are proficient in How comfortable you are in each — be honest, be specific What you have actually built or maintained with them We're not running a quiz — we're looking for self-awareness and depth. Someone who knows three languages deeply interests us more than someone who lists twelve and masters none. // compensation & hours Starting rate: $6/hr, sliding scale based on demonstrated skill and validated expertise. We know what someone with this full stack of capabilities commands on the market — we're not pretending otherwise. We are specifically looking for someone who sees the value in getting in early, growing with us, and earning more as we do. Initial engagement: 2–4 hours/day, 5 days/week, as we establish the working relationship. Growth toward full-time (8 hrs/day) is the goal, and we have real client work that can fill those hours. If you are a seasoned senior-level engineer who sees this and thinks the rate is beneath you — we still want to hear from you. We are maintaining a talent file. As our infrastructure scales, higher-tier paid engagements will follow, and we'd rather already know who we want to call. Additionally, this position can be paired with our general Virtual Assistant opening (posted separately). If you have the technical chops for this role, the admin side is well within reach. That position pays at its own rate for qualifying admin tasks, giving you a potential path to a fuller day's work from day one. // how to apply — read this carefully We are not interested in AI-generated cover letters that mirror our job posting back at us with different formatting. We can spot it. It will disqualify you immediately. What we want to see in your application: Your actual background — where your technical experience came from, how you developed it, what you've built What you are personally into — the technologies you explore on your own time, the rabbit holes you go down for fun The communities you're part of — forums, ---------- servers, GitHub communities, subreddits, open-source projects, anything that shows you live in this world The specific tools and programs you use — be precise, not vague A demonstration that you are a genuine enthusiast — not someone who learned these things for a job, but someone for whom this is a way of life English proficiency is preferred for this role, as a portion of the work involves live collaboration with tea ---------- mbers on calls. That said, if you are a legitimate technical savant who speaks passable English and can communicate clearly in writing, we will prioritize your technical depth over polish. Additional requirements: Strong typing speed, fast reading comprehension, quick analytical thinking, and the ability to context-switch across complex tasks without losing the thread. We are looking for a diamond in the rough. If you don't meet every requirement but you are deeply invested in this world, you learn fast, and you can prove it — apply anyway and make your case.

description: About This Role We are an Australian digital marketing agency that builds professional WordPress websites for local business clients across Australia. We are looking for a skilled Elementor Pro developer to join our team on fixed-price project work, with a genuine pathway to regular part-time hours and potentially full-time employment as our agency grows. We start with fixed-price projects so both sides can build trust and assess the fit properly. There is no set number of projects before any transition happens. It takes as long as it takes, and when both sides are confident in the working relationship, the conversation about ongoing work happens naturally. How It Works Stage 1: Fixed-Price Project Work We agree on the scope and price upfront before any work begins. You complete the project, we review, provide feedback, and pay promptly on completion. This continues for as long as it needs to. Typical projects include: A full multi-page WordPress build from our HTML prototype and written build map Single page or template builds Bug fixes or troubleshooting jobs on existing sites Stage 2: Regular Part-Time Retainer When the working relationship is established and the fit is clear on both sides, we move to a set number of hours per week at an agreed monthly rate. Work becomes more predictable and consistent for both of us. Stage 3: Full-Time (As the Agency Grows) As our client base expands, we want a developer who grows with us. Full-time hours are a genuine possibility for the right person over time. What You Will Be Building Each project is a multi-page WordPress website built to a detailed HTML prototype and written build map that we provide. You do not need to design from scratch. Your job is to translate our approved designs into a pixel-accurate, fully functional WordPress site using Elementor Pro. A typical build includes: Homepage with hero, animated counters, card sections, testimonials, and enquiry forms 5 to 15 inner pages including service pages, suburb or location pages, article pages, and a contact page Global header and footer via Theme Builder Elementor Pro forms connected to email via WP Mail SMTP Schema markup configured via Rank Math or Yoast Mobile responsiveness checked and confirmed on all pages Page speed basics including image compression, clean plugin structure, and no unnecessary code Skills and Experience Required Must have: WordPress and Elementor Pro with a minimum of 80 to 100 completed builds Hello Elementor theme setup and configuration Elementor Pro Theme Builder for headers, footers, and single templates Elementor Pro Form widget with SMTP integration Essential Addons for Elementor including card hover effects and box widgets Google Fonts integration and global font and colour setup Rank Math or Yoast SEO plugin configuration ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) and Custom Post Type UI WP Mail SMTP setup and troubleshooting Responsive design and mobile breakpoint adjustments in Elementor Ability to read and follow an HTML prototype and written build map accurately Clear written English communication and proactive updates Nice to have: Experience with real estate or local service business websites Familiarity with JSON-LD schema markup Basic knowledge of Core Web Vitals and page speed optimisation Experience with WooCommerce or membership plugins What We Provide We are an organised client. When you start a project with us you receive: A complete HTML prototype of every page for visual reference A written Elementor Build Map with section-by-section instructions Global colour codes, font names, and design tokens already defined Form field specifications written out in full Schema markup values ready to copy into the SEO plugin A clear point of contact who responds promptly Payment via PayPal or Wise, promptly on project completion You will never be handed a vague brief and left to figure it out. We do the thinking upfront so you can build efficiently. What We Are Looking For in You Beyond technical skills, we want someone who: Takes ownership and flags problems early rather than going quiet Follows a brief carefully and asks questions when something is unclear Builds sites the right way with no pasted CSS hacks, no bloated plugins, and no custom code where native Elementor widgets will do the job Communicates proactively and honestly about timelines Wants to grow with a team over the long term, not just pick up a one-off gig Is proud of the quality of their work Compensation Project stage: Fixed price agreed per project before work begins. We price fairly for the scope involved. Ongoing stage: Monthly retainer based on agreed hours per week once the relationship is established. We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the most reliable option at a fair price, and we pay accordingly. Please include your expected per-project rate in your application. Applications without a rate indication will not be prioritised. How to Apply Please send us the following: A short introduction about yourself and your Elementor Pro experience Links to 3 to 5 WordPress websites you have built (live sites strongly preferred) Your expected per-project rate Your availability in hours per week and your time zone One sentence on why you are looking for a long-term role rather than short-term gig work Applications without portfolio links will not be considered. A Note on This Opportunity We want to be straightforward with you. We are a small agency that is growing steadily. We work with Australian small business clients and we take the quality of their websites seriously. If you are a developer who takes the same pride in your work, communicates well, and wants a stable long-term arrangement with an employer who respects your time, we think this will be a good fit for both of us. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Full Stack  Developer
description: *** Please include your resume with the number IN-006  as the subject header, along with outlining your relevant experience and qualifications to be considered for an interview. *** About us: At PTOE Global Solutions we deliver fully managed business solutions designed to help business owners scale with confidence. We operate with a collaborative, democratic culture where modern techniques, mindfulness, and strategic innovation meet. If you are passionate about talent development, digital efficiency, and driving high-impact, human-centric transformations, you will find a purpose-driven home with us. Role Summary: PTOE Global Solutions is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build, maintain, and improve web and mobile-enabled business applications to support client projects. This role is responsible for developing reliable, scalable, and user-friendly applications across the full technology stack, from database design and backend APIs to frontend interfaces and integrations. The ideal candidate is not only a coder, but someone who can understand business requirements, think through user workflows, and build solutions that support long-term growth. The developer will work closely with the Head of Solution Delivery, UX/UI designers, product owners, content teams, and client-facing teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. This individual contributor role is designed for an agile technologist who thrives across diverse ecosystems. You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and scaling core business applications, ranging from high-performance PHP web platforms and enterprise systems to user-centric mobile applications. As a vital member of our engineering team, you will turn complex operational requirements into clean, production-ready code, ensuring cross-platform compatibility, security, and exceptional performance across all digital touchpoints. Key Responsibilities: Application Development Develop, maintain, and improve web applications, admin portals, dashboards, client systems, and community platforms. * Build clean, secure, and scalable backend functionality using modern frameworks such as Laravel, PHP, Node.js, or similar technologies. * Develop responsive frontend interfaces using technologies such as Vue, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, Bootstrap, or similar tools. Backend, API & Database Work * Design and maintain database structures, queries, and data models. * Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between applications, third-party tools, payment platforms, email systems, analytics tools, and AI services. * Ensure proper data security, user permissions, authentication, and role-based access controls. * Support reporting, analytics, and data extraction requirements for client and internal applications Frontend & User Experience Implementation * Convert UX/UI designs into functional, responsive, and user-friendly pages. * Ensure applications work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. * Improve usability, page speed, navigation, and overall user experience. * Collaborate with UX/UI Designers and Product Owners to refine workflows before development. Competencies and Qualifications: Preferred Skills * Experience with any of the following would be a strong advantage: * Laravel ecosystem, Livewire, Nova, Filament, or similar admin tools. * Flutter, React Native, or mobile app support. * Payment integrations such as Stripe, PayPal, or in-app subscription workflows. * AI/API integrations, including OpenAI or other AI services. * Community platform features such as groups, feeds, comments, memberships, subscriptions, and notifications. * Reporting dashboards and analytics tools. * Cloud hosting, DevOps, deployment pipelines, cPanel, AWS, DigitalOcean, or similar. * WordPress, Webflow, or CMS integrations. * SaaS product development experience. * Multi-tenant application architecture. * Data privacy, security, and compliance awareness. * Technology Stack Preference * PGS is looking for someone comfortable with, or able to quickly learn: * Backend: PHP, Laravel, Node.js * Frontend: Vue.js, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind * Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL * Mobile Support: Flutter / React Native experience preferred * APIs: REST APIs, third-party integrations, AI APIs * Tools: GitHub/GitLab, Jira, Postman, Figma * Hosting: Digital Ocean, Laravel Forge, or similar Education: Bachelors degree in computers/technology or equivalent work experience. Experience: 10+ years of professional full-stack development experience, with a proven track record of creating and supporting production-ready web and mobile applications. Core Soft Skills: Full-Stack Versatility: The ability to context-switch smoothly between different programming paradigms, from dynamic web scripting in PHP to strong security aligned enterprise code in and mobile UI rendering. * Collaborative Mindset: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to partner with Product Owners, Operations, and Designers to unpack business requirements. * Problem-Solving Ownership: An individual contributor who proactively identifies technical debt, proposes scalable architectures, and prioritizes code quality. * Agile Adaptability: Thrives in an agile sprint environment, balancing multiple feature deliverables while maintaining a focus on performance and application security. What we offer: * Competitive renumeration. * Flexible work hours & full-time remote job. * Opportunity to work on multiple exciting projects in a dynamic. environment. * Collaborative and innovative team culture.

title: Full-Stack Developer — Ventured Hub App & GoHighLevel Integration
job_title: Full-Stack Developer — Ventured Hub App & GoHighLevel Integration
description: Purpose of the Role Ventured Business Hub is a boutique agency that helps small business owners grow through virtual assistance, systems, and strategy. We have been building Ventured Hub — a custom web application designed to replace our current ClickUp setup and become the central operating system for our team and clients. The application is approximately 70% complete, with the core look, structure, and key functionality already in place. This role exists to get it across the finish line. The developer in this role will take ownership of an existing, partially built codebase and complete the remaining features, fix outstanding issues, and optimise performance and usability so the application is ready for daily use by our team. Critically, they will also be responsible for ensuring that Ventured Hub integrates seamlessly with GoHighLevel (GHL) — our CRM and marketing automation platform — so that client data, leads, and workflows flow between both systems without duplication or manual effort. This is a focused, time-bound engagement with a clear goal: a polished, fully functional application delivered within 2–3 weeks. It suits a developer who is confident jumping into an existing codebase, can quickly identify what needs to be done, and delivers clean, working code without needing hand-holding. Background: Where the App Is Now Ventured Hub is a React + Node.js web application built on the following stack: Frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui Backend: Express 4, tRPC 11 Database: MySQL (via Drizzle ORM) Auth: Manus OAuth Hosting: Manus platform (cloud-deployed) can change if required The application is approximately 70% complete. The overall design direction, layout, navigation structure, and core UI components are in place. The remaining work falls into three buckets: 1. Feature completion — several features are partially built or stubbed out and need to be finished to a production-ready standard. This includes the time tracking system, timesheet view, client management structure, and task detail interactions. 2. Optimisation and polish — existing features need performance review, UX refinement, and edge-case handling. The app should feel fast, reliable, and intuitive for a small team using it daily. 3. GoHighLevel integration — the application needs to connect to our GoHighLevel CRM to: Sync client contact records between GHL and Ventured Hub Trigger GHL automations when task statuses change (e.g. when a client project moves to “Complete”, fire a GHL follow-up sequence) Pull lead pipeline data from GHL into Ventured Hub dashboards Optionally: create GHL contacts or update opportunity stages from within Ventured Hub A detailed gap analysis report (comparing our current ClickUp setup to the planned Ventured Hub feature set) and access to the existing codebase are available for shortlisted candidates. Key Responsibilities This is a completion and optimisation engagement, not a greenfield build. The developer will: -Review and onboard quickly. -Spend the first 1–2 days reviewing the existing codebase, identifying what is complete, what is partially built, and what is missing. -Deliver a short written assessment of the remaining work and a proposed completion schedule before starting any code changes. Complete the remaining features. Finish all partially built features to a production-ready standard. Priority areas include: the time tracking and timesheet system (per-task timer, weekly grid, approval workflow), the client management structure (client records, Ongoing Clients / Build Clients views), the Kanban board view, and task detail interactions (subtasks, checklists, attachments, comments, activity log). Optimise existing functionality. Review the completed portions of the app for performance, UX consistency, and edge-case handling. Fix bugs, improve loading states, and ensure the app feels polished and reliable under real daily use. Build the GoHighLevel integration. Design and implement the GHL integration layer: contact sync between GHL and the Ventured Hub database, webhook handling for status-triggered automations, lead pipeline data pull into dashboards, and (optionally) bidirectional opportunity stage updates. Document the integration architecture clearly so it can be maintained and extended after handover. Hand over cleanly. Deliver a brief handover document covering what was built, how the GHL integration works, any known limitations, and recommended next steps. Ensure all backend procedures have Vitest unit tests and the README is current. Communication throughout the engagement should be proactive — a brief daily or every-otherday update via message, and a short video check-in with Paige at the midpoint and on completion. Essential Skills and Qualifications The following are non-negotiable requirements for this role: Technical Minimum 2 years of professional experience building full-stack web applications Proficiency in React (hooks, context, component architecture) and TypeScript Experience with Node.js and REST or RPC-style APIs (tRPC experience is a strong plus) Solid understanding of relational databases and ORM tools (MySQL, Drizzle, Prisma, or similar) Experience integrating third-party APIs via webhooks and REST (GoHighLevel API experience is a strong plus; CRM integration experience is acceptable) Ability to read and extend an existing codebase without breaking existing functionality Familiarity with Git, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows GoHighLevel Specific Working knowledge of the GoHighLevel platform — understanding of contacts, pipelines, automations, workflows, and sub-accounts Experience using the GHL API or webhooks to build integrations (or demonstrated ability to learn quickly from API documentation) Understanding of how GHL automations trigger and how to design integration logic that does not create duplicate records or infinite loops Soft Skills Strong written English communication (all async communication is in English) Ability to work independently, manage your own time, and flag blockers proactively Comfortable asking clarifying questions rather than making assumptions Detail-oriented — our clients rely on accurate time tracking and task data Preferred Skills The following skills are not required but would set a candidate apart: Prior experience building task management or project management tools Experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component libraries Familiarity with Drizzle ORM and schema-first database workflows Experience with ClickUp API or migrating data from ClickUp Experience building approval workflows or multi-step state machines Knowledge of Australian business context or experience working with Australian clients If you have got this far, thank you. As part of your submissions, the first word is to be Stacked (just to ensure you have read the whole instructions), als ensure that the writing is in Aus english. Application Process To apply, please reply to this post 1. A brief introduction (3–5 sentences) explaining your background and why this role interests you 2. Links to 2–3 projects you have built or contributed to — ideally including at least one with API integration or CRM connectivity 3. Your answer to this question: “How would you approach syncing a contact record between GoHighLevel and a custom MySQL database, ensuring no duplicates are created if the same contact is updated in both systems simultaneously?” (There is no single right answer — we want to see how you think.) 4. Your availability and current timezone 5. Your hourly rate expectation in USD/AUD

YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF... Two disciplines. One person. Both at a high level. • You build pages, not just mockups You can open WordPress and ship a page without handing it off to a developer. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js / E2B / Vercel Platforms)
job_title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js / E2B / Vercel Platforms)
description: We're hiring a senior full-stack engineer to help us launch MythOS Pro, an AI-powered operating system for local service businesses (barbershops, salons, restaurants). It's a full platform: CRM, booking/calendar, payments, inventory, a workforce module, an AI agent (Mylo) that runs across all of it, and a website builder. You'll work directly with the founder and grow into a core engineering role as we get launch-ready. Strong English communication required. Priority #1 — Website Builder (the immediate need): Our builder lets a customer import their GitHub repo, edit their Next.js site inside our platform, then push to main, which triggers an automatic Vercel redeploy so their live site updates. We need this pipeline rock-solid: Fix reliability issues with our E2B sandbox (sandboxes sometimes fail to load / dev server doesn't bind correctly on port 3000). Reference: e2b-dev/fragments. Build a clean GitHub repo import flow: clone repo into the sandbox (sandbox.git.clone), npm install, boot the Next.js dev server, expose the preview URL into our editor iframe. Implement edit ? commit ? push-to-main back to the customer's GitHub repo via the GitHub App (installation token). Wire the push to trigger Vercel auto-redeploy, with each customer's site served on their own subdomain via Vercel for Platforms (multi-tenant). Help us finish setting this up. Sandbox lifecycle management: create, auto-pause on idle, resume on edit, kill on session end, with cost controls. Beyond the builder, there's a deep backlog across the whole platform — CRM, booking, payments integrations, inventory, the workforce module, and Mylo's agent capabilities. We want someone who can own significant pieces of the product and help drive us to launch. Our stack: Frontend/API surface (mythOS-pro): Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind, deployed on Vercel. Agent runtime (mythos-claw): a custom Rust runtime that powers our Mylo agent — built on a fork of NEAR AI's IronClaw, blended with OpenClaw, Hermes, GoClaw, and other components. Runs as a long-running service on Google Cloud Run (Postgres/Neon, Redis/Upstash, embedded Hermes worker, Gemini integration). Other: GitHub App integration, E2B sandboxes, Vercel for Platforms (multi-tenant), Claude API, Pinecone vector search. The two runtimes communicate over HTTP — mythOS-pro is the public-facing surface, mythos-claw is the brain. Must have: Deep Next.js App Router + TypeScript experience and the ability to debug deployment/infra issues independently (Cloud Run, Vercel, sandboxed dev environments). Strong bonus / what sets you apart: Rust experience and comfort working in an agent runtime — we'd love someone who can contribute to mythos-claw itself, not just the Next.js surface.

Competitive Salary $$$$ We're looking for our senior engineering and product leader a founding-team hire who will take MindFriend safely to launch and build the platform, and the team, that come after. MindFriend is a mental-health marketplace connecting people with verified, licensed clinicians for online therapy: search, booking, payments, and live video, audio and chat sessions in one place. The platform is built and largely working, with a capable lead developer and a team. We're now bringing in the senior leader who will set the engineering bar, d ---------- when we're ready to launch, and grow both the platform and the team from there with a level of ownership only the earliest tea ---------- mbers ever get. This role carries more weight than most engineering jobs. We handle sensitive health data and host live therapy sessions, so reliability and security aren't features they are the trust the entire category depends on. The person who gets this right will have real authority to do it properly, and will help shape what MindFriend becomes. A word of honesty This is a founding-team role at an early-stage company, which means it is hands-on. You will get into the code. You will run the QA passes yourself. You will test a video session on a bad connection at 9pm because a launch depends on it. You will make calls with incomplete information and live with them. You'll lead a small team and a freelance bench but you'll lead by doing, not just directing. If you want a purely strategic seat with people beneath you to execute, this is the wrong role. If you want to own the hardest, most consequential technical problems in the company and see them through, read on. Requirements What you'll be responsible for •     The launch decision setting the readiness bar, and holding launch until it's met. •     Reliability of live video, audio and chat sessions on a user's old laptop and a clinician's poor wifi, not just a developer's machine. •     Security and privacy of sensitive health data the controls that keep us defensible, and an independent security review before we go live. •     End-to-end quality of the booking-and-payments flow, including the failure paths most teams skip. •     The product direction after launch what we build next, in what order, and why. •     Leading and growing the engineering and product team. What success looks like In your first weeks — to launch: •     Own and close out the launch readiness bar; get MindFriend live in its first market with confidence, not crossed fingers. •     Pass an independent security review with critical findings remediated before go-live. •     Prove the full booking-to-session flow end-to-end, including every failure path, across real devices and networks. In your first 6–12 months: •     Turn a freelance-built platform into a maintainable, well-owned codebase with a team to match. •     Establish a sane delivery cadence and the engineering and product processes we'll scale on. •     Set the post-launch roadmap and start shipping against it. Who you are •     8+ years building software, with senior or lead engineering experience and you've carried real product responsibility, not just executed someone else's spec. •     You've shipped a consumer product that takes real payments and handles sensitive personal data, to production and through real users. •     You've worked somewhere the security and data bar is real health-tech, fintech, or similar. You're not learning why it matters here. •     You can run a security review and stand up the controls behind it yourself, not just brief someone else to. •     Hands-on operator first, leader second: you lead through doing. •     You work directly and candidly with a non-technical founder. title: Backend / Operations Manager
description: About us We run a portfolio of fast-growing e-commerce brands across Australia, the UK, US and Canada. Our flagship is a designer lighting brand; the portfolio also spans fashion and home. We're profitable and scaling hard — which means the operational side now needs a dedicated owner instead of being run off the founder's desk. The role in one line Own the day-to-day backend of every store so the operation runs cleanly without the founder in the loop — and turn the money we currently lose to refunds, chargebacks and fulfilment issues into margin we keep. This is not a ticket-closing job. You'll run the operation and improve the systems behind it. Right now roughly 15% of profit leaks to refunds and related issues. Your core mandate is to bring that down meaningfully (target: under 5%) through better process, not just faster firefighting. What you'll own Fulfilment & orders — Make sure every paid order ships within 48 hours, supplier transit times are met, and no order ever sits open. D ---------- on substitutions and out-of-stock situations using our playbook. Refunds — Apply our refund decision matrix (replacement-first where appropriate, store credit before cash, cause-based logic). Approve within your limit; escalate above it. Tag every refund by cause and whether it was preventable. Customer support quality — You don't do the CS yourself; you run quality control over a distributed support team. Monitor first response time, enforce correct template usage, make sure refund/issue tickets get prioritised and resolved fast. Chargebacks — Respond within processor deadlines with proper evidence, and — more importantly — find the root causes and seal the leaks. Keeping our chargeback rate healthy is a priority. Data & optimisation — Own data integrity across our sheets and dashboards. Surface where the leakage concentrates (which supplier, SKU, market) and propose the one or two fixes that move the number each month. This is the part of the job that actually compounds. KPIs you'll be measured on - Refund cost as % of profit (by cause) — trending down - Customer first response time within target - % of issue tickets resolved within 3 exchanges - Chargeback count and % preventable - Orders processed within 48h / supplier SLA hit rate - Data completeness across all tracking You're a fit if you: - Have run operations or backend for a Shopify / dropshipping business before (multi-store and multi-market is a strong plus) Are comfortable with the stack: Shopify, Google Merchant Center, a CS platform (we use Re:amaze), email /Klaviyo, spreadsheets/dashboards, Notion - Think in systems — you instinctively turn a recurring problem into a rule or a process, not a repeated manual fix - Are fully fluent in written English and excellent at concise, no-fluff async communication - Are reliable, self-directed, and able to make decisions inside clear guardrails without checking in constantly - Are numbers-literate — margins, COG, refund rates, chargeback rates mean something to you Nice to have: experience disputing chargebacks, supplier/SLA management and comfort with custom dashboards. How we work: - Fully remote, full-time. - Async-first. You'll run a short daily written standup, a weekly KPI report, and a monthly optimisation note. Real-time messages are reserved for genuine escalations. - You get a clear SOP (decision matrix) from day one and a structured onboarding where you take over tasks in phases over your first 8 weeks. - We measure you on outcomes, not hours online.

title: Civil Engineer Designer
description: About Sera Engineered Sera Engineered is a US-based civil engineering firm specializing in high-end residential and commercial land development. We provide a holistic suite of services including landscape architecture, utility design, stormwater management, surveying, and certified arborist work. We pride ourselves on precision, environmental stewardship, and design documents that set the industry standard for clarity and technical accuracy. The Role We are seeking an Advanced Civil Design Engineer to serve as a technical lead within our production team. This is not a "redline drafter" position. We are looking for an engineer who understands the "why" behind the "how." You will be responsible for the engineering logic of our site designs, ensuring that grading, drainage, and utilities are not only compliant with US codes but are optimized for construction and environmental preservation. Core Responsibilities Comprehensive Site Engineering: Develop full construction document sets from raw survey data, with a primary focus on grading, drainage, and utility infrastructure. Stormwater Management (SWM) & Hydraulics: Perform complex hydrological calculations (Rational Method/TR-55) to size detention facilities, water quality structures, and conveyance systems. Advanced Utility Coordination: Design and profile gravity sewer (10" SSWR) and pressurized water systems (8" W), proactively identifying and resolving vertical and horizontal conflicts (clash detection). Environmental Integration: Incorporate arborist-led constraints into the civil design, specifically protecting Critical Root Zones (CRZ) and establishing Limits of Disturbance (LOD) to meet strict environmental regulations. Quality Control (The CIV200 Standard): Take full ownership of the CIV200 sheet series. Ensure all plans reflect the Sera Engineered legend, keynotes, and aesthetic standards—delivering "permit-ready" sets that require minimal revision. Proactive Problem Solving: Identify potential field issues (e.g., ADA slope non-compliance or utility crossings) during the design phase to prevent costly Change Orders. Technical Requirements Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering (Licensed Engineer preferred). Experience: 5+ years of experience in US-based land development or site civil design. Software Mastery: Expert-level AutoCAD Civil 3D proficiency is mandatory (Surfaces, Pipe Networks, Pressure Networks, Alignments, and Data Shortcuts). Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of US-based design standards, including ADA accessibility and local municipal drainage codes. Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, capable of explaining complex engineering logic clearly. Operational Compliance Workflow: Must be disciplined in time-tracking via QuickBooks (using our "Project ID – Project Name" naming convention). Payroll: Payments are processed exclusively through Globalization Partners (G-P). Security: Must maintain a high Audit Point (AP) score (20 preferred) and possess a current, valid NBI Clearance.

job_title: Founding Systems Integrator — GoHighLevel, AI Automation & No-Code/Low-Code Systems
description: # PAY Starting monthly compensation in PHP, based on experience, proof of work, expected weekly hours, and fit. We are cost-conscious because we are still early-stage, but we will pay fairly for someone who can actually solve the right problems. This may start part-time or ramp up over time depending on workload, performance, and mutual fit. # ROLE TYPE Remote contractor role. Long-term opportunity for the right person. # COMPANY Atlas Cybertech --- # ABOUT THE COMPANY Atlas Cybertech is a Canadian AI automation and systems company building internal platforms, CRM infrastructure, automation workflows, and operational systems. We are early-stage and moving quickly toward revenue. That means we need to get our baseline systems live fast, without creating a fragile mess that breaks later. Good-enough, working systems are better than perfect systems that never launch. But “good enough” still needs to be clear, testable, and maintainable. We are not looking for AI hype, random tool-stacking, or “automate everything” thinking. We are looking for someone who can help us build practical MVP systems quickly, especially around GoHighLevel, AI-assisted workflows, no-code/low-code tools, automations, integrations, and internal operations. --- # ROLE SUMMARY This is a *GoHighLevel-heavy role.* GoHighLevel is one of the most important platforms in our business, so you must have real hands-on GHL experience. This role is not GHL-only, but strong GHL ability is central. You will help build and improve Atlas Cybertech’s internal systems across: - GoHighLevel - CRM workflows - No-code/low-code tools - Automations - Forms and intake flows - System of Record structures - Internal portals or dashboards - AI-assisted documentation and SOPs - Light AI-assisted workflows - API/webhook-based integrations where needed We are especially interested in someone who is personally excited about AI and actively experiments with AI tools, AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, automation tools, and new ways to use AI to build faster and work smarter. You do not need to be a full-stack software developer or AI engineer. You do need to be technically sharp, AI-curious, systems-minded, and capable of figuring things out. --- # JOB MISSION Your mission is to help get Atlas Cybertech’s internal operating stack online quickly, then improve it over time. The first priority is helping us get our core MVP systems configured, connected, tested, documented, and usable. The goal is to create systems that: - Reduce manual work - Help us move toward revenue faster - Keep data reasonably clean - Avoid silent failures - Make workflows easier to understand - Make automations easier to troubleshoot - Support future client delivery - Can be documented, maintained, and handed off later This role is ideal for someone who naturally asks: - How do we get this live quickly without making a mess? - Where is the bottleneck? - What data should live where? - What happens if this automation fails? - What is the simplest working version? - How can AI help us build, document, or troubleshoot faster? - How can another person maintain this later? --- # WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You may help with: - Building and improving GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, tags, custom fields, calendars, forms, automations, snapshots, triggers, and integrations. - Setting up and troubleshooting GHL sub-accounts, workflow logic, CRM stages, and client-style account structures. - Helping structure data in systems like SmartSuite, Airtable, or similar tools. - Connecting forms, CRM, automations, dashboards, portals, and documentation workflows. - Building no-code/low-code automations using tools like Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar platforms. - Troubleshooting broken workflows, triggers, integrations, data-sync issues, and automation failures. - Creating AI-assisted SOPs, workflow maps, field maps, process notes, Loom walkthroughs, and system documentation. - Helping build internal systems for hiring, onboarding, lead handling, client intake, follow-up, and operations. - Supporting AI-assisted workflows where AI helps the process but does not become the source of truth. - Using AI-assisted light coding where appropriate for small scripts, API calls, webhook troubleshooting, data transformations, or internal workflow helpers. - Improving system reliability, error visibility, speed of execution, and handoff readiness. You do not need to be a professional writer, but you do need to care about leaving clear notes and using AI tools to make documentation faster and easier. --- # IMPORTANT ARCHITECTURE PRINCIPLE We separate tools by role. - The System of Record is the main source of truth for important business data. - GoHighLevel is the CRM and workflow layer. - Forms are for intake. - Portals and dashboards are for viewing or interacting with data. - Automation tools move data and trigger workflows. - AI tools can assist, but they do not own the process. GoHighLevel is very important, but it is not automatically the System of Record for everything. If this distinction makes sense to you, this role may be a strong fit. --- # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE You should have real experience with: - GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, tags, custom fields, triggers, calendars, forms, and automations. - GHL troubleshooting and workflow behavior. - CRM setup, pipeline logic, and automation logic. - No-code/low-code automation tools such as Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar. - Basic API/webhook concepts. - Data fields, records, statuses, permissions, and workflow stages. - Troubleshooting broken automations or integrations. - Clear documentation, SOPs, workflow maps, or process notes. - Explaining technical decisions in plain English. - Using AI tools to improve speed, research, documentation, troubleshooting, or technical implementation. You should also have strong personal interest in AI. Ideally, you already spend some of your own time testing, researching, or experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Codex-style tools, AI coding assistants, AI agents, automation agents, or other AI tools. You do not need to be a full-stack software developer or AI engineer. You do need to be technically sharp enough to understand workflows, data movement, integration logic, AI-assisted workflows, prompting, failure points, and system handoff. --- # HIGH-PRIORITY EXPERIENCE These are especially valuable: - GoHighLevel snapshots - GHL SaaS mode - GHL agency/sub-account setup - GHL AI features or AI Employee-style workflows - Client account cloning or snapshot deployment - Twilio or SMS/calling workflows - A2P / SMS approval workflows - AI appointment-setting bots - AI voice/SMS/chat workflows - Advanced AI tools, AI coding tools, agentic tools, or automation agents The more experience you have with GHL and AI-assisted systems, the better. --- # STRONG BONUS EXPERIENCE These are not all required, but they are useful: - SmartSuite - Airtable - Fillout - Softr - Noloco - Bubble / Glide / Loveable - Google Workspace / Google Drive - Microsoft 365 - Meta / Facebook Ads lead flow - Lead forms, UTM tracking, pipeline attribution, or conversion tracking - KPI dashboards or funnel reporting - Lightweight JavaScript, Python, JSON, or API troubleshooting - Experience supporting agencies, consultants, founder-led companies, or service businesses You do not need to be a media buyer, but paid ads platform literacy is a plus because many systems will connect to lead generation workflows. --- # THIS ROLE IS *NOT* FOR YOU IF Please do not apply if: - You are mainly a VA with light tool experience. - You only know basic GHL admin tasks. - You only build funnels and landing pages. - You only know simple Zapier automations. - You describe yourself mainly as a prompt engineer. - You want a CTO, executive, or management title. - You prefer custom code before checking simpler options. - You add new tools before understanding the current system. - You automate unstable workflows without mapping them first. - You do not like documenting your work. - You give vague answers like “I can automate everything.” - You rely on AI-generated answers without real examples. - You are not personally interested in learning and testing new AI tools. This role is not for beginners. --- # WORKING STYLE This role is a good fit if you are: - Strong with GoHighLevel. - Highly interested in AI tools and automation. - Practical and MVP-minded. - Systems-minded. - Strong at troubleshooting. - Fast, but not reckless. - Comfortable figuring things out independently. - Clear in written and spoken English. - Comfortable working directly with a founder. - Willing to use AI to speed up documentation and technical work. - Able to explain tradeoffs clearly. - Willing to challenge weak ideas respectfully. - Focused on building systems that other people can maintain later. We want speed, but not reckless speed. Good-enough, working systems are better than perfect systems that never launch. But “good enough” still needs to be clear, testable, and maintainable. --- # AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES You will be expected to recommend, build, test, troubleshoot, and document systems. However: - You do not choose new core platforms without approval. - You do not turn GHL into the System of Record by default. - You do not add tools without a clear reason. - You do not build custom-code dependencies unless clearly justified and approved. - You do not redesign the core architecture without discussion. The founder makes final architecture and platform decisions. Your role is to recommend, execute, document, and improve. --- # HIRING PROCESS The hiring process is designed to avoid long live interviews. Shortlisted applicants may complete: - A short recorded screening - A more detailed scenario-based assessment - One paid practical task if selected as a finalist - A short 10-15 minute founder call as the final step The paid practical task is only for finalists. We do not ask many candidates to do unpaid project work. --- # HOW TO APPLY At the top of your application, write this exact phrase: *Atlas Systems* Then answer the questions below. Please answer all screening questions directly in your application. Applications that do not answer the questions will not be considered. Generic AI-written answers will be rejected. Use specific examples from systems you have personally built, fixed, documented, improved, or tested. --- # APPLICATION QUESTIONS 1. Evidence of Ability In 3-5 bullet points, describe the strongest evidence of your ability for this role. Focus on difficult systems, GoHighLevel builds, automations, workflow problems, AI-assisted builds, or technical issues you personally solved. 2. Proof of Work Share any relevant proof of work. Examples: - Loom videos - Screenshots - Diagrams - SOPs - Documentation - Portfolio links - Workflow maps - Case studies Do not share confidential client data. 3. Tool and Skill Experience List the main tools or tool categories you have real experience with. For each category, mention the specific tools, what you personally used them for, and your approximate skill level from 1-10. Categories: - GoHighLevel / CRM systems: Workflows, pipelines, snapshots, SaaS mode, sub-accounts, automations, troubleshooting - Automation tools: Make, Zapier, n8n, Pabbly, Relay, or similar - No-code/low-code tools: Airtable, SmartSuite, Fillout, Softr, Noloco, Bubble, Glide, or similar - AI tools / AI coding / agentic tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Codex-style tools, Gemini, DeepSeek, AI agents, AI coding tools, automation agents, or similar - API / webhook / data integration work: Webhooks, JSON, API calls, data transformations, scripts - Paid ads / lead-flow systems: Meta Ads, lead forms, tracking, attribution, conversion events, UTM/source tracking - SMS/calling systems: Twilio, A2P, calling/SMS workflows, notification systems - Business ops tools: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, Google Sheets You are not expected to know every tool listed above. These are examples to help you explain your experience clearly. GoHighLevel experience is the most important. Strong AI interest and automation ability are also very important. The more relevant tools and systems you know, the better. 4. Availability and Starting Compensation Please provide the following: - Desired starting monthly compensation in PHP for the first 1-3 months while onboarding, learning our systems, and ramping up. - Number of hours per week this monthly amount assumes. - Maximum hours per week you are available to work consistently. - Target long-term monthly compensation in PHP after the first 1-3 months, assuming strong performance and good fit. - Usual work window in Philippine time, such as morning, afternoon, evening, late night, overnight, or flexible. - Earliest available start date. --- # FINAL NOTE We are cost-conscious because we are still early-stage, but we will pay fairly for someone who can actually solve the right problems. We are looking for the best mix of capability, reliability, speed, judgment, AI interest, GHL ability, and reasonable cost. If you enjoy building systems, solving technical puzzles, experimenting with AI tools, improving workflows, and making operations run better, this role may be a strong fit.

description: ABOUT US We are building a new kind of real estate platform in the United States. It is called The Buyer Listing Service. Today, real estate websites only show homes that are for sale. We are building the buy side of the market for real estate agents. On our platform, real estate agents post buyer want-listings, not for sale listings. Our system then uses AI to match both buyer agents and seller agents together. We work directly with the official real estate databases (called MLSs) that agents use across the US. More of these databases are signing up with us every month and we're growing fast. We are a small and fast-moving team. When you write code here, it ships quickly and real people use it. This is a rare chance to help build a brand-new product from a growth stage, take real ownership, and grow with the company. THE KIND OF PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for an experienced engineer who can work independently. Over time, you will own and run large parts of this platform. We are relying on your expertise. This is not a junior role and we are not looking for someone we train from the basics. If you need a senior developer checking all of your work, this is not the right fit. If you want real ownership and the chance to be the technical expert on a growing product, it is a great fit. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Build and improve features across our website and our backend API • Review and merge code changes (we use a clean pull request workflow on GitHub) • Connect and clean real estate data from different sources so it fits our system • Use AI tools (like Claude) to help map and clean messy data • Work closely with the founder and one other developer, and increasingly own your areas YOU MUST HAVE • 4+ years of professional full-stack experience, and the proven ability to work on your own • Strong fundamentals, not just frameworks. You can explain how JavaScript works (for example, the event loop), how the web works, and how to model and query a SQL database. • Strong skills in Node.js and Express • Strong skills in React • Comfortable writing raw SQL (we use MySQL, no ORM) • Real experience integrating and cleaning messy data and APIs from other systems • A habit of learning on your own. You have personal projects or things you built to teach yourself. • Clean Git habits and small, focused pull requests • Good written English (most of our work is async and in writing) • Able to follow written rules and instructions exactly HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI We use AI tools like Claude every day and we want people who use them well. But we are hiring an experienced engineer, not a person who copies and pastes from a chatbot. You should be able to explain why your code works, and fix it when the AI gives a wrong answer. In our process we will always ask you to explain your decisions, so deep experience matters more than fast answers. NICE TO HAVE • Experience with AWS • Experience using AI or LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) in real projects • Experience with data pipelines or ETL HOW WE WORK • We write small, focused changes. We do not refactor code that is not part of the task. • We follow a written set of rules for the codebase. Following instructions matters more here than working fast. • We welcome AI tools. We want people who use them well to do more. HOURS Full-time, 40 hours per week. We would like you to work US East Coast hours if you can. This helps you work at the same time as the rest of the team. HOW TO APPLY 1. Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this post. 2. Send a link to one project you built and are proud of. Tell us in 2 or 3 sentences what it does, what part you built, and why you built it that way. Be ready to explain your choices on a call. 3. Tell us your experience with Node, React, and SQL, and the largest project you have owned or led. 4. Tell us if you have used AI or LLM tools in your work, and how. Our process is a short call, then a deeper technical interview, then a small paid task using fake data, then a short call to walk through your code together. We will reply to strong applicants.

On the IT side, we manage our clients' networks, servers, Microsoft 365 environments, endpoints, and phone systems. On the security side, we design, install, and support their video surveillance and access control systems. We do things differently from most MSPs: we don't run a Tier 1 help desk. When a client reaches us, they get a skilled engineer who takes ownership immediately, not a scripted first-tier queue or an automated phone tree. We're hiring part-time to cover our weekends, Saturday and Sunday, and we have additional weekday evening shifts available for the right person. Weekends and evenings are much quieter than our weekday daytime operation, so this isn't a high-pressure call queue. You'll handle the calls, email s, and tickets that do come in, owning each from first contact through resolution, and spend the rest of your time moving project work forward: deployments, configurations, maintenance windows, documentation, and backlog cleanup. Weekends and evenings are also when we can safely take systems offline for upgrades that would disrupt clients during the day, so a meaningful part of this role is planned project execution, not just reactive support. The weekend coverage is what we're most eager to fill. If you're interested, you can also pick up one or more weekday evening shifts on top of it; the full schedule is below. Because you'll often be our main presence outside core business hours, independence and sound judgment matter here. You won't be alone: you'll have escalation paths to senior engineers and the owner, and we take on the hardest problems as a team, but you should be comfortable owning a client environment and knowing when to escalate. The role is fully remote, and you'll be a full member of our team, not an isolated, outsourced contractor. What You'll Do - Handle client requests by phone, email , and ticket during your shifts, and own them from first contact through resolution - Deliver a confident, professional experience on every interaction; clients should feel they're in good hands from the first minute - Execute project work handed off from the weekday team: deployments, migrations, network and system configuration, and backlog items that need uninterrupted time to complete - Run maintenance windows: patching, firmware upgrades, server maintenance, and other changes best done while clients are offline - Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD): user and license provisioning, Exchange Online, mail flow, and email security - Monitor and respond to RMM alerts (Atera) and manage endpoint security tools (Huntress, Bitdefender) - Troubleshoot networks: firewalls (FortiGate), switches and access points (UniFi), VLANs, VPNs, and DNS - Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy - Manage and verify backups (Datto) - Support VoIP systems and IP phones - Configure, support, and troubleshoot video surveillance systems (IP cameras, NVRs, and video management software such as Hikvision, Digital Watchdog, and Speco), including secure remote access and viewing - Administer access control systems (users, credentials, and door schedules) and troubleshoot controllers and readers - Remotely support our field technicians during security-system installs and service calls - Keep clear, accurate documentation for every client environment, including writing up the project work you complete - Work alongside our AI tooling, which we use heavily across daily operations What We're Looking For - 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally at an MSP - Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong customer-first attitude; you'll be the voice of our company on every call - The confidence to own client interactions and project work independently, along with the judgment to know when to involve the team - Self-direction: with lighter supervision outside business hours, you should be able to pick up a project, see it through, and document it without hand-holding - Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals - Hands-on experience with firewalls and managed switches (FortiGate and UniFi a strong plus) - Experience with IP video surveillance and/or access control systems, or the aptitude and willingness to develop this expertise quickly (it's a core part of what we do) - Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection - A quiet, dedicated home workspace Bonus Points - Deep familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude, which we use extensively day to day - Spanish-speaking ability (written and/or spoken) - Hands-on experience with VMS platforms (e.g., DW Spectrum), access control systems, or remote video monitoring services (e.g., Immix) - Certifications (CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Microsoft, Fortinet NSE, Ubiquiti, Cisco CCNA) - PowerShell or other scripting Work Setup - 100% remote, based in the Philippines - Part-time, permanent employee position, not contract work - All hours are in US Eastern Time, which maps to an overnight or early-morning shift in the Philippines (about an hour later when the US is on standard time) Weekend coverage, the core of this role (both days): - Saturday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sat to 10:00 AM Sun PHT) - Sunday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sun to 10:00 AM Mon PHT) - About 24 hours per week Optional weekday evening shifts, pick any one, two, or all three: - Tuesday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Wed PHT) - Thursday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Fri PHT) - Friday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Sat PHT) - 5 hours per shift What We Offer - Competitive USD pay, scaled to the shifts you take (same hourly-equivalent rate across all of them): - Weekend coverage (Saturday and Sunday): $1,200 to $1,500 per month, based on experience - Each weekday evening shift you add: approximately $250 to $315 per month per shift - For reference, taking all five shifts works out to roughly a full-time load at about $1,950 to $2,450 per month - Paid time off, pro-rated for a part-time schedule - A stable, long-term role with real room to grow, including the potential to expand into more hours - A supportive, AI-forward team that invests in its people How to Apply To apply, send your resume and a short note about your MSP and IT experience, including any hands-on work with security systems and AI tools, and let us know which shifts you're available for: weekend coverage, weekday evenings, or both.

The app also generates spec sheets and PDF quotes from the configured design. The 3D side is already functional. We have working flat and gable patio builders, dynamic rafter and beam generation, house attachment, measurement labels, and a server-side rendering path for preview images. Now we want someone strong in Three.js to help us take the 3D experience to the next level. Current stack Three.js (WebGL) for all 3D rendering. GLB/GLTF models for houses, roof components, gutters, fascia and more. Vanilla JS with a Babel build pipeline, Express/Node backend, EJS views, Stripe for payments and Firebase for auth. What you'll work on Improving geometry accuracy across dynamic rafters and beams, gutters, roof pitch and wall attachment. Parametric model generation that stays correct as dimensions change. GLB model integration, materials, lighting and visual polish. Performance optimisation and clean, maintainable scene code. Fixing edge case bugs in the flat and gable builders. You should have Solid hands-on Three.js experience on real projects, not just demos. A good grasp of 3D math including transforms, geometry, materials and lighting. Comfort working in a vanilla JS codebase with no heavy framework. Bonus points for parametric or CAD-style modelling, GLTF/GLB authoring, and performance tuning. How to apply Send a short intro, links to your Three.js work or portfolio (live demos strongly preferred), and your availability and expected monthly rate. Applications without portfolio links will not be considered.

Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Strong understanding of x86 architecture and system booting processes. Proficiency in low-level programming languages, such as Assembly and C/C++. Experience with BIOS and UEFI firmware development, including familiarity with related standards and protocols. In-depth knowledge of boot loader technologies, including boot stages, boot protocols, and boot loader customization. Familiarity with system-level debugging tools, such as JTAG, GDB, and kernel debuggers. Experience with firmware development tools, such as Intel System Studio, UEFI Development Kit (UDK), or similar. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex boot-related issues. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet project deadlines. Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience in designing boot loaders for embedded systems or real-time operating systems. Knowledge of security features and considerations related to booting and firmware development. Familiarity with virtualization technologies, such as Intel VT-x or AMD-V. Experience with Linux kernel development, Linux containers, and knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes. Familiarity with the FlexBuild tool for building Linux systems or similar build automation tools. Join our team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge x86-based computer systems. As an x86/ARM System Boot Loader Designer, you will have the opportunity to work on complex firmware development projects and play a vital role in shaping the booting experience of our products, leveraging your knowledge and experience with Linux Kernel, Linux containers, and FlexBuild tool.

Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work.
